{{Top|leg}}
The '''Droid motion sensors Type 3''' was the most sophisticated upgrade version of [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field]] detection sensors available for [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. This model of upgrade was primarily purchased for special-duty droids guarding sensitive materials or [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Head of State/Legends|heads of state]].

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 3 to be able to equip this item.
